name: QA 2115
description:
PCP QA Test No. 2115



Check for memory errors when fetching derived metrics from an archive.



__pmLogFetch() constructs a "no values available" pmValueSet by aliasing

a pmid_ctl struct over vset[j] (see the "two tricks" comment there).

That struct is only as big as the pmid and numval fields, so reading

vset[j]->valfmt from one is 4 bytes off the end of the allocation.

__dmpostvalueset() used to read valfmt unconditionally.
